title: Distributed Zeroth-Order Optimization with Rademacher Perturbations and Momentum Gradient Tracking
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization is indispensable for complex non-convex tasks where explicit gradients are computationally prohibitive or strictly inaccessible. For deploying ZO methods over distributed heterogeneous networks, the gradient tracking technique is often employed to eliminate structural data biases. However, the inherent variance of derivative-free estimators is also amplified. To overcome this problem, we propose Zeroth-Order Momentum Gradient Tracking (ZO-MGT), which integrates momentum-based variance reduction with dynamic gradient tracking.
